acceptance.observed: Post-run hooks object has exactly four event keys: SessionStart and PostCompact each hold one command group invoking '/private/tmp/agent-harness-lane-456/source/bin/agent-harness' hook session-start|post-compact --host claude (unchanged managed contract); PreToolUse still holds only the seeded third-party group 'third-party-lint-tool --check' (untouched, correctly out of scope for the merge since no agent-harness command was present there); Stop now holds only the seeded third-party group 'third-party-notify-tool --stop' -- the co-resident legacy agent-harness Stop group was removed by the same merge pass that preserved the third-party one; UserPromptSubmit is absent entirely, because its only group was the legacy agent-harness hook and removing it left the event empty, which the installer deletes.
